acceptanceCriteria: The reference is calibrated per window or the fixed constant is justified by measurements across at least two hosts.
body: Residual of PR #1501 (V1-2201/#1406). Also: on macOS, burners at equal priority never caused a miss (contended run needed nice 12); the idle run shared a host at load 45-280.
title: AHI-172 latency verdict uses a fixed 2 ms probe reference; candidate/probe ratio ranged 3x-28x across runs, so calibrate the reference per host
